description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Cloud Technology Lead to drive the design, implementation, and governance of secure, scalable cloud and distributed platform architectures across enterprise and blockchain ecosystems. This role requires deep expertise in multi-cloud security, zero-trust identity, software supply chain security, Kubernetes platform engineering, runtime detection engineering, Smart Contract Security Auditing, Protocol Engineering (L1/L2), and MEV Engineering (Maximal Extractable Value).

⦿ 10+ years of experience in Cloud Security, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, or Infrastructure Security.

⦿ Deep expertise in AWS, Azure, and GCP cloud platforms.

⦿ Strong experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure.

⦿ Hands-on implementation experience with:

◘ SPIFFE / SPIRE enterprise federation

◘ In-Toto full pipeline enforcement

◘ Tekton Chains production attestation

◘ Custom OPA enterprise governance platforms

◘ eBPF kernel-level detection engineering

⦿ Strong understanding of Zero Trust Architecture and cryptographic workload identity.

⦿ Experience implementing software supply chain security frameworks (SLSA, provenance, attestation).

⦿ Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code and policy-as-code governance models.

⦿ Strong programming/scripting skills (Go, Python, Bash, Terraform, YAML).

⦿ Experience leading enterprise cloud modernization initiatives.

Core Technical Skills:

⦿ SPIFFE / SPIRE

⦿ Tekton Chains

⦿ In-Toto

⦿ eBPF

⦿ SLSA Frameworks

⦿ Protocol Engineering (L1/L2)

⦿ MEV Engineering

⦿ Cryptographic Identity Systems

⦿ OPA / Gatekeeper

Preferred Qualifications:

⦿ Experience with Smart Contract Security Auditing tools and methodologies.

⦿ Exposure to Protocol Engineering (L1/L2) and distributed consensus systems.

⦿ Understanding of blockchain infrastructure, validators, and decentralized systems.

⦿ Experience with MEV Engineering (Maximal Extractable Value) analysis and blockchain transaction monitoring.

⦿ Familiarity with blockchain observability, threat detection, and decentralized governance.

⦿ Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKA, CKS, or cloud security certifications preferred.

Description
Responsibilities include but not limited to the following:
1. Agile Project Planning and Execution:
  • Facilitate the creation and refinement of at least 2-3 product backlogs per major initiative, with a minimum of 20 user stories defined and prioritized within the first sprint cycle.
  • Lead and coach 2-3 cross-functional Agile teams (comprising IT developers, OT engineers, data analysts, and domain experts) through the entire Agile lifecycle.
  • Ensure the execution of at least 2-week sprint cycles, with a commitment to delivering demonstrable increments of value at the end of each sprint.
  • Manage and track project progress using Agile tools with daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives conducted consistently.
2. Stakeholder Management and Communication:
  • Conduct weekly stakeholder update meetings with key representatives from Traffic Operations, Maintenance, IT Infrastructure, Cybersecurity.
  • Develop and maintain a stakeholder engagement plan that identifies at least 10 key stakeholders and outlines their communication needs and frequency.
  • Provide bi-weekly project status reports to the Program Management team, summarizing progress, risks, impediments, and upcoming sprint goals.
3. Risk and Impediment Management:
  • Identify, assess, and document at least 5-10 potential project risks per initiative, developing mitigation strategies for each.
  • Proactively identify and remove at least 2-3 impediments per sprint that hinder team progress. * Maintain a risk and impediment log that is reviewed and updated at least weekly.
4. IT/OT Convergence Integration:
  • Facilitate at least 1-2 cross-functional workshops per quarter to ensure seamless integration
  • between IT and OT systems, addressing at least 3-5 key integration points per workshop.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure all implemented solutions meet at least industry-standard cybersecurity compliance requirements for transportation infrastructure.
  • Ensure that at least 90% of technical documentation related to IT/OT interfaces is reviewed and approved by relevant stakeholders.
5. Performance Measurement and Reporting:
  • Define and track at least 3-5 key performance indicators (KPIs) for each initiative, aligned
  • with project objectives (e.g., system uptime, data latency, incident resolution time).
  • Produce monthly performance reports that analyze KPI trends and provide actionable insights. * Conduct quarterly project reviews with senior leadership to assess overall project health and strategic alignment.
Mandatory Qualifications
1 72 months of experience in Agile Project Planning and Execution
2 72 months of experience managing projects that involve the integration of Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems
3 72 months of experience managing projects specifically within the transportation sector (e.g., intelligent transportation systems, traffic management, public transit technology).
4 72 months of experience with Stakeholder Management and Communication by developing and maintaining a stakeholder engagement plan, and completing bi-weekly project status reports
5 60 months of experience with Performance Measurement and Reporting
6 60 months of experience facilitating stakeholder meetings and resolve conflicts among diverse business, technical and security teams.
7 MUST hold at least one of these Certifications
** Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) OR Professional Scrum Master (PSM)
** Project Management Professional (PMP) with an Agile Practice Guide endorsement.
